cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The parcel depot closes at six. Your mother's waiting outside the station. Which am I collecting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then do you want her waiting for me or waiting for her present?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Get the parcel. I'll call her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's calling me now. Shall I pull over to explain, or keep driving before the depot shuts?

mechanism: A uses each practical update as a prioritization lesson, requiring B to select which urgent obligation should lose time.
confusable: Not just asking directions: both options remain duties with costs, and A makes B choose rather than deciding for it.
comparison: Household hands occupied versus a collection route with a closing depot and a waiting person.
seedUse: Keep D34 parcel/Mum/birthday/phone sequence; S05 grade the pupil selection and return it to the next conflict.
